ECDICT classroom vocabulary dictionary
Source: https://github.com/skywind3000/ECDICT
License: MIT; full upstream notice is retained in LICENSE and packaged in the app.
Snapshot: 2026-10-23; source SHA256 and counts are recorded in SOURCE.json.

The bundled SQLite dictionary is derived with scripts/build-vocabulary.py.
It contains English words, pronunciation, Chinese definitions, vocabulary tags,
and resolved inflection aliases. Definitions are looked up locally; they are not
generated by a language model. Entries without an available definition are skipped.

Basic exclusion combines the source middle-school tags, high-frequency entries,
and a small common-function-word list. High-school/CET4/CET6 lists use ECDICT tags
cumulatively. These community-curated lists are not represented as official exam
syllabuses. User-known words add a personal exclusion layer.

Small mathematical-definition additions (isomorphism, homomorphism,
differentiation, derivative, eigenvalue, eigenvector, bijection, surjection,
tensor) are explicitly maintained in the build script. Original meanings are
retained below these additions; upstream phonetics are not altered.
